record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: ELEKID (1 star), ELECTABUZZ (2 stars) and ELECTIVIRE (3 stars) declare ABILITY SHOCKWAVE with maxPP 100 and range 1; none declares a passive. All three are ELECTRIC/ARTIFICIAL (plus HUMAN or BABY).
record.summary: Area special damage around the caster that falls off with distance. Every enemy within radius 2 of the caster (radius 3 while the caster's status.electricField is true) takes SPECIAL damage of round(base x (1 - 0.2 x d)) where base is 30/60/120/240 by caster stars (fallback 240) and d is the Chebyshev distance from the caster to the enemy: x0.8 at 1 cell, x0.6 at 2, x0.4 at 3. Each enemy is a separate handleSpecialDamage call (own AP, crit, block and bounce handling). The cast target passed to process is not used; the area is centred on the caster. The caster's own cell is excluded and allies are untouched.

targeting.who: every enemy (team different from the caster) in the area around the caster
targeting.note: requiresTarget keeps the default true, so the caster needs a target in its range-1 attack reach to cast, but process ignores the target and hits everyone in the radius.

geometry.shape: filled disc around the caster, caster's cell excluded; radius 2 normally, 3 with electricField
geometry.detail: getCellsInRadius uses floor(r) + 0.5 and includes a cell when dx^2 + dy^2 < r'^2. Radius 2 (2.5, limit 6.25): offsets (0,1),(1,0),(1,1),(0,2),(2,0),(1,2),(2,1); (2,2) is out. Radius 3 (3.5, limit 12.25) adds (0,3),(3,0),(1,3),(3,1),(2,2); (3,2),(2,3),(3,3) are out. Distance for damage is Chebyshev max(|dx|,|dy|), so (1,1) is distance 1, (2,1) and (2,2) are distance 2, (3,1) is distance 3.

effects.target: each enemy in the area, once each

declaredRaw.formula: handleSpecialDamage(Math.round(damage x (1 - 0.2 x distanceC)), board, SPECIAL, caster, crit)

effects.scaling: REQUESTED amount per target: table value x (1 - 0.2 x Chebyshev distance), rounded before the hit (distance 1/2/3 gives x0.8/0.6/0.4; distance 3 is reachable only with electricField). Applied before defence by handleSpecialDamage: damage + damage x AP/100 (apBoost defaults true), x2 and the effect consumed when the caster has DOUBLE_DAMAGE (consumed by the first enemy hit, so only the first processed enemy doubles), x1.2 with the strange steam board effect on target or caster, and when the cast crit: x(1 + (critPower - 1) x reduction), reduction 1 minus 0.1 per Black Augurite owned by the target's player, 0 for a Rocky Helmet target.
effects.resolution: Each scaled amount goes to PokemonState.handleDamage (defence, shields, minimum of 1 and takenDamage: see core-mechanics section A). An enemy with protect, skydiving or magicBounce takes nothing from its own hit (takenDamage 0); magicBounce additionally reflects a SPECIAL hit back to the caster after 500 ms unless the caster holds Protective Pads, so several bouncing enemies each reflect. Cells are scanned in getCellsInRadius row-major order.

starBehavior.note: The caster's stars index the damage table (30, 60, 120, 240; fallback 240). Radius and falloff do not depend on stars. Catalog units here are 1 (ELEKID), 2 (ELECTABUZZ) and 3 (ELECTIVIRE) stars.

record.positionalConditions: Area centred on the caster. Enemies at Chebyshev distance 1 take 80% of the table value, distance 2 take 60%, distance 3 (only with electricField) take 40%. electricField is a status flag set by other effects (e.g. VOLT_SURGE, passives, terrain pulse, items); how the caster obtains it is outside this record.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state in the strategy. Two modes by the caster's electricField flag at cast time: radius 2 without it, 3 with it.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested per enemy: round(30/60/120/240 x (1 - 0.2 x distance)). Applied before defence: x(1 + AP/100), DOUBLE_DAMAGE x2 (first hit only), strange steam x1.2, crit factor. takenDamage after PokemonState.handleDamage (defence, shields, minimum of 1) is a separate lower number. Blocked hits report takenDamage 0.
